completionSentence: 주 모델 transport가 실패해도 허용된 다른 모델이 같은 Work를 이어가며, 부분 답을 최종 답으로 저장하거나 이미 실행한 Tool·외부 효과를 반복하지 않는다.
qualified: Fallback is disabled by default and uses only connection ids explicitly allowed by the user policy.
Only transport, provider health, credential and required-capability failures admit another model; quality, invalid tool arguments, HTTP 400 and user cancellation do not.
The next model receives canonical T5 messages and ToolReceipts, never a provider raw transcript.
A successful exact Tool call requested again immediately after fallback is returned as not_executed before dispatch.
An already-authenticated GitHub CLI read followed by primary-model transport failure completes through the fallback model with one CLI execution.
A partial or failed provider response is not published as the final user answer.
Every transition is durably recorded as t5.model-continuity-receipt.v1 and projected without credentials.
A real transition event is emitted once while the fallback guard remains active across later model responses.
notClaimed: Fallback to a connection the user did not allow
Live outage qualification for every provider pair
